Você será responsável por garantir a entrega contínua de dados transformados e governados, desde a ingestão até a disponibilização para consumo analítico. Sua atuação contribuirá diretamente para a qualidade, confiabilidade e acessibilidade dos dados, sendo um membro fundamental na equipe de engenharia de dados. Como será seu dia a dia? Apoiar a construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados no Databricks, utilizando notebooks, jobs e pipelines;
Garantir a entrega contínua das camadas Bronze, Silver e Gold dentro da arquitetura de dados;
Ingerir, transformar e disponibilizar dados para consumo analítico;
Criar e manter tabelas Delta e views para suporte a dashboards e análises;
Atuar com compartilhamento e consumo de dados via Delta Sharing;
Apoiar a governança de dados utilizando Unity Catalog, gerenciando catálogos, schemas e permissões;
Monitorar execuções de pipelines, identificar falhas e realizar troubleshooting;
Corrigir causas-raiz e propor melhorias de confiabilidade e performance;
Implementar e/ou apoiar validações de qualidade de dados;
Documentar pipelines,regras de negócio e a linhagem básica dos dados;
Colaborar com analistas, times de BI e áreas de negócio para entendimento de requisitos e evolução das entregas. Para esta vaga, é essencial: Conhecimento sólido de SQL (joins, agregações, CTEs, window functions e modelagem básica para analytics);
Conhecimentoprático de Python para dados (manipulação, leitura/escrita e organização de código em notebooks);
Noções de Apache Spark/Databricks (DataFrames, particionamento, leitura/escrita em Delta e execução distribuída em alto nível);
Experiência inicial com Databricks (uso de notebooks, jobs, clusters e boas práticas básicas);
Familiaridade com pipelines de dados e arquitetura Medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold), mesmo em contexto acadêmico ou projetos;
Conhecimentoem Git e controle de versão (branch, PR e resolução simples de conflitos);
Capacidade de investigar problemas (logs, métricas simples, reprocessamentos) e comunicar status com clareza;
Disponibilidade para atuar com sustentação de rotinas, acompanhando falhas e correções dentro do horário acordado. Você pode se destacar se: Tiver experiência com Azure Data Factory (pipelines, triggers, integrações, parâmetros, monitoramento). Possuir conhecimento prático de Unity Catalog (permissões, data access, boas práticas de governança). Tiver vivência com Delta Sharing (publicação/consumo e cuidados com segurança e contratos de dados). Possuir experiência com orquestração e automação (Databricks Workflows, CI/CD, Databricks Repos, Azure DevOps/GitHub Actions). Tiver conhecimento em Data Quality e Observabilidade (ex.: Great Expectations/Deequ, métricas, SLIs/SLOs, alertas). Possuir experiência em otimização no Databricks/Delta (partitioning, Z-ORDER, OPTIMIZE/VACUUM, caching, controle de custos). Tiver noções de modelagem dimensional e consumo por ferramentas de BI (camadas semânticas, performance para dashboards). Possuir conhecimento de segurança e boas práticas (RBAC, segregação de ambientes, secrets, princípios de menor privilégio). Curtiu a oportunidade? Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente! ✨

Familiaridade com arquiteturas de sistemas, pipelines de dados e boas práticas de integração de APIs (REST, GraphQL). Diferenciais: Experiência com AI Generativa e modelos LLMs (ex.: GPT, BERT). Experiência com orquestração em nuvem com ferramentas como airflow, data factory, Databricks pipelines. Experiência em com Docker, Docker Compose, Kubernetes ou ferramentas como Azure Container Apps (ou relativas). Vivência em ambientes com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban). Experiência colaborando em projetos com arquitetos de soluções ou times comerciais.

title: Clinical Study Manager
description: Job Summary The Clinical Study Manager (CSM) will be part of the Clinical Operations Department, which is responsible for planning, executing, managing and closing studies associated with the company clinical development plans. The CSM is a proven leader in clinical development with study management experience in the pharmaceutical or device industry. The CSM provides leadership and support to members of the multidisciplinary program teams, internally and externally, and can successfully thrive in a virtual clinical model. The CSM reports to the Senior Director of Clinical Operations and may be based at Liquidia's headquarters in Research Triangle Park, North Carolina, or remote.Specific Duties, Activities, and Responsibilities Act as a patient advocate throughout the clinical development project lifecycle, with a mindset to minimize patient and site burden when participating in clinical trials. Understand and support trial milestones including site identification and assessment, patient/subject recruitment, Key Opinion Leader (KOL) and Steering Committee development, and medical affairs support as required. Coordinate internally with Medical and Quality Assurance to identify risks to clinical trial projects. Participates in the development of study timelines, in coordination with the internal study team and external partners. Manages the trial according to agreed timelines. Develop Requests for Proposals for vendors (CRO, Bioanalytical Labs, Central Safety Labs, Data Management groups, etc.) required to support clinical studies. Assist or lead the vetting of vendors and sites for study participation. In collaboration with Program Leaders, lead the development and updates of study specific protocols, consent forms, and other trial related materials (e.G., Study Monitoring Plan, Data Management Plans, CRFs, site training materials, Advertising Materials, etc.) as required. Oversee the work of CROs and other vendors (Central Labs, Clinical Supply Distributors, etc.) as assigned to clinical trials. Identifies potential risks to timelines, budgets, and quality, and participates in establishing and overseeing mitigation strategies with the internal team members and external partners, as applicable. Manage and track clinical trial budgets to include forecasting, review, and approval of vendor and site payments. The CSM is also responsible for notifying management of anticipated change orders and/or budget adjustments proactively Assumes primary accountability for assigned clinical trial execution according to protocol requirements, trial plans, company SOPs, ICH-GCP, FDA regulations, and applicable regulations in other regions. Collaboratively work with the project team and other CRO/vendor resources and timelines associated with all study activities, including CRO/investigator agreements, central IRBs, database development and maintenance, monitoring strategy, QA audit plan, and coordination of Clinical Safety Review Teams when applicable. Supports material planning and management to ensure appropriate execution of the clinical projects, including but not limited to distribution of documents, forms, supplies, equipment, and investigational product. Reviews reports from study data systems which show progress of data collection, source document verification, and query resolution. Reports untimely data entry to Program lead. Collaborates with Program Lead and medical monitor to ensure adverse event review and coding review occur on the timelines detailed in study plans. Assists with review of study data reports during the cleaning phase of a study (i.E. prior to interim analysis or database lock) and aligns with team on any issues needing escalation. Ensure the Trial Master File (TMF) is maintained and up to date and all documents are accounted for by completion of clinical study report. Generate compelling periodic trial Newsletters to communicate important trial aspects to trial sites. Ensure the development and maintenance of trial-specific tracking systems to enable proper study management and monitoring activities, as required Work with the Senior Director of Clinical Operations, or similar to ensure that internal program team members are trained appropriately on study conduct Serve as a liaison between external partners and internal team to ensure program specific information and ongoing updates are proactively communicated Participates in the development, review, and implementation of departmental SOPs, processes, and initiatives. Attend off-site meetings and conferences, as needed. Mentorship of junior colleagues in Clinical Operations and other departments in areas of oversight to foster development and expansion of junior colleague skill sets.Education and Experience Bachelors with a minimum of five years of experience in clinical research, with at least two years of clinical project/study management. Experience qualifying & managing external vendors (e.G. CRO, Call Center, Central labs, etc.). Experience managing clinical project team personnel. Experience leading operational teams through the start-up, study conduct, data management, and report writing of clinical studies. Experience liaising cross-functional teams internally and with external partners to align on program expectations. Experience reviewing and editing protocols and clinical study reports. Demonstrates knowledge of Good Clinical Practices and all applicable US regulations governing clinical research, as well as working knowledge of the FDA submission process. Experience in Global clinical studies and country/region specific regulations governing clinical research outside of the US. Excellent organization and communication skills, including experience dealing with decision makers such as physicians and IRB members. Demonstrates problem-solving and interpersonal skills.Must have a 'can-do' attitude and a strong desire to take ownership of many different projects. Ability to work independently and manage multiple timelines, while maintaining the team focus. Demonstrated ability to exercise judgment and determine appropriate action to a variety of problems of varying complexity. Demonstrated ability to manage multiple deadlines.Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Strong desire to join a small company and work in a fast-paced environment. Ability to work with remote teams and to negotiate with external providers. Must be detail oriented, highly organized, reliable, and accurate. Must be a motivated self-starter, adaptable, and capable of working within a matrix environment. Must display sound judgment and discretion as well as problem solving abilities especially within a team environment. Experience with tools and systems for managing clinical rials (CTMS, TMF, EDC, ePRO database, Microsoft suite, etc.).. Compelling interpersonal verbal, written and presentation skills in communication with internal and external customers. Must have the ability to accommodate international and domestic travel up to 30% at the request of the business. Must be fluent in English

title: Full-Time Project Lead
description: About Us BlueTuskr is a rapidly growing full-service digital marketing agency specializing in e-commerce brands. Our team is highly collaborative and committed to delivering exceptional results for our clients, helping them grow and scale their businesses. As we continue to expand, we're looking for a full-time Project Lead to join our team and oversee the day-to-day pipeline of client projects. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced agency environment and enjoys bringing structure, organization, and momentum to complex marketing initiatives. What You'll Be Doing You'll be responsible for managing the lifecycle of multiple client projects, ensuring timelines are met, teams stay aligned, and deliverables meet client expectations. This role sits at the center of our internal operations, coordinating efforts across design, content, strategy, and paid media teams while maintaining clear communication with stakeholders. The ideal candidate has: 3-5 years of project management experience 1-2 years of marketing agency experience ( some e-commerce experience is preferred). A strong understanding of marketing workflows, including content creation, paid media, SEO, and creative production. Proficiency in project management tools, especially Asana. Excellent organizational and time-management skills. Exceptional communication and interpersonal abilities. A problem-solving mindset with a focus on continuous improvement. The ability to multitask and manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 1. Project Planning & Execution (50% of your time) Develop and manage detailed project plans, timelines, and budgets. Break down projects into actionable tasks and assign responsibilities across teams. Ensure tasks are completed on time, within scope, and aligned with client goals. Proactively identify and resolve potential roadblocks. Monitor progress, making adjustments to plans as needed to stay on track. 2. Team Coordination & Communication (30% of your time) Serve as the main point of contact between internal teams and clients. Facilitate regular check-ins, stand-ups, and progress meetings. Ensure seamless communication and collaboration between departments (design, content, strategy, etc.). Provide clear direction and ensure team members understand priorities and deadlines. Foster a positive, productive environment and help remove any obstacles. 3. Performance Monitoring & Reporting (20% of your time) Track project performance, including key metrics like timeline adherence, budget management, and client satisfaction. Prepare and present progress reports to leadership and clients. Analyze project data to identify areas for improvement in efficiency and processes. Contribute to refining workflows and improving project management methodologies. Salary The starting salary for this position is between $3000 and $3500 USD per month, depending on experience. SO, if you are a highly motivated and skilled Project Manager with experience in marketing and e-commerce, AND you'd like to have the opportunity to join a growing marketing agency and be part of an invaluable team, we can't wait to hear from you!

title: Arquiteto De Dados
description: A Brunel está apoiando uma empresa do setor de georastreamento na busca por um(a) Data Engineering Team Lead para liderar iniciativas estratégicas de dados e impulsionar a evolução da sua plataforma. Inglês fluente. Diferenciais Experiência com pipelines de AI/ML e serviços como AWS SageMaker ou Azure Synapse. Vivência com governança de dados e qualidade. Background em sistemas distribuídos, APIs ou arquiteturas orientadas a eventos. Formação e Experiência Mais de 6 anos de experiência em Data Engineering (hands-on). ensure adoption of architecture standards. Run design reviews and architecture signoffs;
surface and mitigate risks and complexity early. Translate standards into guardrails and automation (policyascode, selfservice) for consistent delivery. Drive roadmap and execution: Provisioning: Self-service engines, Crossplane/Terraform-based automation, policy-as-code, secured pipelines, access management, backups/restore, Azure AI resource provisioning, and quota management. Reliability: Observability integrations (New Relic, Azure Monitor), performance tuning, autohealing, DR/BCP, resilience testing, failover automation, SLOs, reliability for Azure AI services and messaging platforms (Kafka, Event Hubs, Service Bus). Establish engineering excellence: Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/Crossplane) and CI/CD best practices. Change management with safe deploys and rollback strategies. Incident and problem management with blameless postmortems. Continuous improvement loops measured by DORA/SRE metrics. auditability and evidence collection. Partnership with Security/Compliance for standards and reviews. Partner with the Architects: Codevelop platform architecture and service standards. Define SLIs/SLOs and capacity/reliability patterns for core services. Align roadmaps and run design reviews for high-impact changes. Maintain a defensible, visible backlog that reflects real risk and business impact — not just the loudest stakeholder. Standardization of provisioning via Terraform/Crossplane for databases, messaging, and AI services. Governance for Azure AI services (quotas, access, safety guardrails) with clear consumption patterns for product teams. Success Metrics Reduced MTTR and incident count, improved SLO attainment for data/middleware services. Improved lead time for change and change failure rate;
increased automation coverage and reduced toil. Faster time to provision and higher first success rate for self-service requests. Measurable improvements in cost efficiency, performance, and capacity predictability. Team health: engagement, growth, hiring velocity, stress levels, and retention. SLO attainment for AI endpoints and messaging services;
reduced alert noise viaimproved observability (New Relic/Azure Monitor). What You Will Bring Proven experience managing SRE/platform/infrastructure teams delivering production-critical services. Deep familiarity with Azure and the team stack: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Cosmos DB;
Redis;
messaging systems such as CloudAMQP/RabbitMQ, Kafka, Event Hubs, and Service Bus. Strong reliability fundamentals: SLOs/SLIs, incident and problem management, capacity, DR/BCP, performance tuning. Solid automation background: IaC (Terraform/Crossplane), CI/CD (Azure DevOps), GitOps, policyascode, secrets and identity, RBAC. Track record of building selfservice platforms and reducing toil. Excellent crossfunctional leadership with product, security, and compliance partners. Experience operating Azure AI services in production (Azure OpenAI, Cognitive Services, AI Search). Observability experience with New Relic, Azure Monitor, and OpenTelemetry. What You’ll Need Advanced skills in English Experience with AI-assisted operations and troubleshooting. Observability expertise (Prometheus/Grafana, New Relic, Azure Monitor, OpenTelemetry). Database performance engineering and query optimization. Experience in regulated environments and security frameworks. FinOps capabilities (cost governance, forecasting, rightsizing, quotas, budgets, chargeback/showback). How We Work Collaboration first with a strong partnership between the Engineering Manager and the Architects. Automation by default;
security and reliability are nonnegotiable. Blameless postmortems, continuous learning, and measurable outcomes. Participation in an equitable on-call rotation with high-quality runbooks and automation. Tech Environment Azure (AKS, managed databases, storage, networking, identity). Azure AI services (Azure OpenAI, Cognitive Services, AI Search). Azure DevOps for CI/CD. CloudAMQP (RabbitMQ). Databases: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Cosmos DB. Caches: Redis. Queues/Brokers: Kafka, Event Hubs, Service Bus. Terraform/Crossplane, GitOps. Observability: New Relic, Azure Monitor, logs, metrics, traces, alerting workflows.

title: Head Of Professional Services (Saas)
description: A Jorni está apoiando uma scale-up em alto crescimento na tarefa de encontrar a pessoa para ocupar a posição de Head of Professional Services. Sobre a vaga e a empresa abaixo. ** Sobre a Empresa Somos uma scale-up de tecnologia SaaS B2B em fase de alto crescimento. Operamos em um ambiente dinâmico, de estrutura organizacional horizontal, focado em inovação tecnológica e atendimento a contas de nível Enterprise. Nossa plataforma utiliza Inteligência Artificial e integrações complexas para gerar eficiência e previsibilidade na operação de grandes clientes. O Desafio A posição de Head de Professional Services é um pilar estratégico para a expansão do negócio. Quem assumir este papel terá a missão executiva de liderar a operação de implantação de tecnologia, sendo a principal liderança responsável por garantir um Go-Live ágil, reduzir o Time-to-Value (TTV) e transformar a área de implantação em uma linha de receita rentável e escalável para a empresa. Principais Responsabilidades Gestão de Professional Services e Monetização: Estruturar propostas de escopo de trabalho (SOW), precificar pacotes de serviços de implantação, gerenciar o P&L da área e garantir a entrega de projetos complexos respeitando as margens financeiras estabelecidas. Liderança e Escala de Times: Gerenciar e desenvolver outros líderes e liderados (coordenadores/gerentes/analistas), orquestrando uma equipe multidisciplinar direta e indireta com mais de 10 pessoas (incluindo arquitetos de solução, gerentes de projeto e analistas). Orquestração Técnica e Arquitetural: Liderar tecnicamente as agendas de implantação em contas Enterprise, conduzindo discussões com áreas de tecnologia de clientes sobre integrações via APIs REST, Webhooks e grandes ERPs. Métricas de SaaS: Proteger o negócio contra o churn de onboarding, alinhando as entregas de projetos às métricas de subscrição B2B (LTV, CAC, TTV) e retenção de receita. Inovação e IA: Liderar a implantação de módulos complexos do produto, incluindo soluções baseadas em Inteligência Artificial Generativa e LLMs. Governança e Processos: Construir e adaptar fluxos de entrega e rituais operacionais que suportem o crescimento acelerado, mantendo a flexibilidade exigida por uma scale-up de estrutura horizontal. Requisitos e Qualificações Gestão Executiva: Mínimo de 5 anos de experiência em cargos de gestão formal, com histórico comprovado no gerenciamento de outros gestores e administração de orçamentos (P&L). Cultura Scale-up: Vivência prévia na construção e adaptação de processos do zero em startups ou scale-ups de alto crescimento. Domínio de SaaS B2B: Profundo conhecimento das métricas de negócios baseados em assinaturas recorrentes (TTV, Churn, LTV, CAC). Profundidade Técnica: Capacidade arquitetural avançada para discutir viabilidade e desenhar integrações de sistemas (APIs, JSON, Webhooks, bancos de dados, ERPs) diretamente com executivos técnicos (CTOs) de clientes Enterprise. Conhecimento em IA: Vivência prática com projetos tecnológicos que envolvam a implantação de soluções de Inteligência Artificial e LLMs. Delivery e Projetos: Especialidade na operação de implantação corporativa, com foco em gestão de cronogramas críticos, mitigação de riscos e monetização do serviço prestado. Perfil Comportamental Desejado Buscamos uma liderança pragmática e direcionada a resultados, com facilidade para transitar entre conversas estratégicas de negócios no C-Level e discussões arquiteturais profundas. É essencial ter resiliência para lidar com ambientes de incerteza e habilidade para simplificar cenários de alta complexidade tecnológica para grandes clientes.

Conhecimento em Observabilidade: Experiência técnica com a stack Prometheus, Grafana e Alertmanager, além de gestão de logs (Fluentd, Loki, Elasticsearch). description:

Key Responsibilities: Team Leadership Lead and manage a pod of 4–8 Engineering Design Specialists by assigning tasks, reviewing deliverables, removing blockers, and mentoring on problem design, simulation rigor, and documentation. Act as the main point of contact with AI research teams to translate model feedback into refinements, while running regular syncs, tracking progress, and reporting updates and risks to program leads. Problem Design (Individual Contribution) Personally design a portfolio of high-difficulty electrical engineering problems in your chosen subdomain. Set the quality bar and design philosophy for the pod through your own example submissions. Electrical Engineering Subdomains: You must have deep expertise in at least one of the following, with working familiarity across others being a strong plus: Analog / Mixed-Signal IC Design — op-amp topologies, ADC/DAC design, noise analysis, layout-aware design, SPICE-level simulation. Power Electronics — DC-DC converters, inverter design, magnetics sizing, thermal management, efficiency optimization. RF / Microwave Engineering — filter design, impedance matching, S-parameter analysis, transmission line and antenna design. Digital Systems / FPGA / ASIC — RTL design, timing closure, synthesis-aware design, hardware-software co-design. Embedded Systems — microcontroller/DSP-based design, real-time constraints, peripheral interfacing, power budgeting. Required Qualifications: Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering or a closely related discipline. At least 5 years of hands-on electrical engineering design experience, with a track record of owning designs from specification through validated implementation. At least 1–2 years of experience in a technical lead, senior engineer, or team coordination role. Proficiency with Python for scripting, automation, and simulation workflows. Hands-on experience with Docker: building images, writing Dockerfiles, managing containerized environments. Familiarity with at least one cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure) — comfortable running workloads, managing storage, and monitoring jobs. Proficiency with at least one open-source EE simulation tool (e.G., ngspice, PySpice, Qucs, OpenEMS, scikit-rf, or similar). Nice-to-Have: Experience designing engineering coursework, exam problems, or design challenges at graduate level. Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines or automated testing frameworks. Exposure to LLM evaluation, AI benchmarking, or training data curation. Cross-domain familiarity with Control Systems, Embedded/Robotics, or Power Systems. Evaluation Process: Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form. Shortlisted candidates will receive a Job Interest Form. After the initial profile review, we will share an assessment, which must be completed within 24 hours. Based on the assessment submission and your responses, we may schedule an interview round. Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to discuss the pre‐onboarding requirements. After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. title: Data Operations Analyst
description: About Us: YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments. Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world's top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence. We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery. What It's Like to Work at YipitData: YipitData isn't a place for coasting—it's a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you'll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers. Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData: Ownership That Matters: You'll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes Rapid Growth: We compress years of learning into months Merit Over Titles: Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you're hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you've been waiting for. About The Role: The Data Operations Analyst plays a critical role in transforming messy, raw product data into high-quality metrics that our retail and brand customers rely on to analyze performance and make decisions. The core of this role is applying strong judgment to shape imperfect data into consistent, scalable, and analytically meaningful outputs. Each customer has unique business questions, data structures, and definitions of success. The Data Operations Analyst works closely with internal teams to interpret these needs, resolve ambiguity in the underlying data, and design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, and customer expectations. This role requires strong analytical thinking, comfort working with incomplete or inconsistent data, and accountability for delivering reliable metrics at scale. As Our Data Operations Analyst, You Will: Transform raw, messy product and transaction data into structured, customer-ready metrics. Apply judgment to resolve ambiguity in data, including handling incomplete, incorrect, or inconsistent inputs. Define and implement rules and logic that make data analytically meaningful and comparable over time. Build and maintain mappings, benchmarks, and normalization approaches that allow customer data to be analyzed at scale. Execute product categorization and attribution when needed as part of broader metric-building workflows. Identify data quality issues and determine appropriate tradeoffs when perfect data is not available. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to plan and deliver data projects on time and with high accuracy. Ensure consistency and reliability of outputs across customers while accounting for customer-specific nuances. Continuously improve processes and workflows to increase efficiency, accuracy, and scalability. Take ownership of deliverables and be accountable for the quality and usability of the final data. You Are Likely To Succeed If You Have... 1–3 years of experience working in a data-focused role such as data operations, analytics, research, or data quality. Strong analytical judgment and comfort making decisions in ambiguous or imperfect data environments. Experience turning raw data into structured outputs, metrics, or analyses that others rely on. The ability to reason through edge cases, inconsistencies, and tradeoffs in real-world data. High attention to detail paired with an understanding of how data decisions impact downstream analysis. Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills. The ability to manage multiple projects and priorities while maintaining accuracy and accountability. Clear communication skills, including the ability to explain data assumptions and decisions to internal stakeholders. Experience using SQL, Python, or similar tools for data exploration, validation, or automation. Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher). Technical Skills (Helpful but Not Required): Comfort working with large datasets using spreadsheets, internal tools, or data platforms. Familiarity with data transformation, data quality checks, or analytics workflows. Exposure to product, retail, or consumer data is a plus. What We Offer: Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings. Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more! Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. Personal laptop Health and wellness package Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Technical Product Owner
description: ABOUT US Syniti, part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data. Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy. Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data. Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively. THE ROLE We are seeking a highly technical and execution‑driven Technical Product Owner to serve as the “engine room” of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‑level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‑native, AI‑driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the “Golden Record” through seamless end‑to‑end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance. What You’ll Do Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions. Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios. UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‑class workflows within SKP. Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‑functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value. Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define “What Good Looks Like.” Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‑world user behavior. Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage. WHAT IT TAKES The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure). The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance “plumbing.” Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus. The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication. The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‑zone teams. The Academic: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience. The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams. Key Skills Visionary Leadership: Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals. Advanced Governance Concepts: Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules. AI/ML Application: Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‑matching or data‑cleansing logic. Visual Communication: Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment. Technical Storyboarding: Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity. Relationship Orchestration: Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement. Drive for Results: Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‑moving environment. Be fully aligned with our core values: Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have. Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday. Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day. Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family. By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process. WHAT WE OFFER Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing. Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story. Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone. Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all. Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them. An open organisation. Hierarchies are not our thing, and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone’s work is seen, and ideas are valued. OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team. We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

title: Sustainability Specialist
description: Junior Sustainability Specialist Location: Remote (Brazil) Contract: 6 months - 40 hours/wk Rate: $4-6/hr USD - BRL $4,330-5,200 / month Job Description Insight Global is looking for an entry‐level Sustainability Analyst / Sustainability Specialist to join our client's growing sustainability function. This role will support a small, highly collaborative sustainability team of two and will play a hands‐on role in sustainability reporting, environmental impact analysis, and data‐driven research initiatives. This is an excellent opportunity for a new graduate with relevant academic or project experience, or an early‐career professional (1–3 years of experience) looking to grow their career in corporate sustainability within a global SaaS organization. The role is fully remote within Brazil and requires strong English communication skills due to close collaboration with international stakeholders. Key Responsibilities Support sustainability reporting initiatives, including data collection, validation, and preparation of internal and external sustainability disclosures. Perform Excel‐based data analysis related to environmental and sustainability metrics, including working with large datasets to identify trends and insights. Assist with environmental impact reporting, including drafting written content and supporting documentation for sustainability reports and customer‐facing materials. Conduct customer and market research related to sustainability programs, expectations, and reporting requirements. Collaborate closely with the sustainability team and cross‐functional partners to support ongoing sustainability initiatives and operational priorities. Required Skills & Experience Bachelor's degree in Sustainability, Environmental Science, Environmental Studies, Business, Economics, Data Analytics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Experience supporting sustainability or ESG reporting through academic projects, internships, or professional roles. Strong Excel skills, including data analysis using pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, and basic data validation techniques. Experience conducting structured research and synthesizing findings into clear written outputs. Strong written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively in a global, remote environment. Nice to Have Exposure to carbon accounting, greenhouse gas (GHG) inventories, or climate‐related data analysis. Familiarity with sustainability or ESG frameworks (e.G., GRI, SASB, TCFD, CDP) through coursework or practical experience. Experience working in a SaaS, technology, or professional services environment. Comfort working independently in a small team where priorities may evolve quickly. We may use artificial intelligence tools to assist with the screening, assessment, or selection of potential applicants for this position.

title: Staff Mobile Engineer
description:

O que você vai encarar no dia a dia: Definir o direcionamento técnico do time. Mentorar e direcionar o time na tomada de decisão. Trazer a perspectiva de engenharia para os problemas propostos. Pesquisar e explorar problemas e possíveis soluções. Conectar o time. Eventualmente, escrever códigos complexos. Apoiar o EM a desenvolver tecnicamente o time. Liderar tecnicamente o time. Coordenar projetos Cross. Atuar junto aos PM's e stakeholders. Criar uma arquitetura de soluções de impacto cross. O que esperamos de você: Que você se comunique bem, que seja organizado e que seja um bom líder técnico. Empatia é um pilar importante da nossa cultura, assim como trabalhar bem em equipe. Ser resolutivo, capaz de tomar decisões sejam fáceis ou difíceis em momentos estratégicos e saber delegar tarefas também são requisitos importantes para nós. Assim como ser mão na massa e ter habilidade para influenciar pessoas e conduzir mudanças organizacionais em tecnologia e processos. Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento mobile, com arquitetura escalável e alta performance (preferencialmente nativo). iOS: Swift, Xcode, gerenciamento de dependências (SPM/CocoaPods) e/ou Android: Kotlin, Android Studio, Gradle. Arquitetura MVVM (ViewModel, layers, separação de responsabilidades). Testes unitários (XCTest no iOS / JUnit no Android;
mocks/stubs). Experiência com Firebase (Crashlytics e Analytics). Conhecimentos sólidos em git para releases atômicas, escaláveis e reversíveis e fluxos de PR / code review. Integrar e evoluir soluções com Firebase (Analytics, Crashlytics, Remote Config, Performance, etc.). Clean Architecture, modularização, SOLID. Seria interessante para nós se também tivesse: Experiência em evangelizar e implementar práticas de desenvolvimento seguro. Experiência resolvendo problemas em produção, empregando contramedidas conforme necessário, bem como atuando em soluções definitivas de longo prazo. Proficiência em padrões de arquitetura de sistemas e princípios 12 Factor para desenvolvimento de aplicações escaláveis e resilientes. O que a Turbi oferece pra te apoiar nessa jornada? Salário competitivo no modelo PJ, alinhado com o mercado;
Saúde em dia: plano de saúde SulAmérica pra cuidar de você. Sorriso garantido: plano odontológico Bradesco. Corpo em movimento: acesso ao Gympass pra treinar do seu jeito. TurbiFree todo mês: R$ 1.000 pra usar nossos carros como quiser. Pausa merecida: 30 dias de recesso remunerado depois de 12 meses com a gente. Parabéns com folga: Day Off no seu aniversário pra comemorar como quiser. Licença maternidade estendida: mais tempo pra viver esse momento com tranquilidade. Licença paternidade: presença garantida nos primeiros dias mais importantes. Bônus: Atrelado ao atingimento de metas da Turbi e individuais. Nosso jeito de trabalhar: A Turbi é feita por gente real, que erra, aprende, cresce e faz acontecer. Por aqui, autonomia anda junto com responsabilidade. A gente valoriza um ambiente seguro pra falar o que pensa, construir com liberdade e ter conversas difíceis com respeito. A gente valoriza pessoas que aprendem, se desafiam e querem gerar impacto de verdade. Se viu aqui? Então se inscreve e vem com a gente transformar a mobilidade urbana!

description: Overview: If you think CRO is just changing button colors to green, running\ "best practice\" listicles you copied from a competitor, or obsessing over Conversion Rate instead of Revenue Per Session—do not apply. Your job is to close the gap between the Actual Customer Journey and the Optimal Customer Journey. The 5 Pillars Audit: You will constantly audit client sites to find the weakest pillar—whether it's a weak Offer, a confusing UX, or a Hero Section that fails the\ "1-Second Test. est Design: You will design A/B, Multivariate, and Reverse A/B tests. You will ensure we hit 95% Statistical Significance and maintain a\ "Do No Harm\" approach. Evolutionary Redesign: You will systematically upgrade our clients' sites—from PDPs to PLPs to Homepages—without ever needing a risky\ "Big Bang\" relaunch. ntel Over Wins: Even if a test loses, you extract the intel. You understand that learning why something failed is just as valuable as a revenue lift. Requirements: 3+ years in CRO or high-level E-com Strategy. Mastery of the 5 Pillars of a Website (Offer, UVP, Copy, Creative, UX). Deep experience with GA4, Heatmaps (Revenue-based preferred), and Screen Recordings. bility to spot Friction, Flow, and Focus in user session recordings. trong copywriting skills—you know how to write a\ "Dream Outcome\" headline anda\ "How\" sub-headline. Experiência com padrões de arquitetura: metadata-driven designs, cache distribuído (Caffeine/Redis), event-driven, repository pattern. * OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO ENDOCRINOLOGISTA NA TELADOC HEALTH\ " Junte-se àNossa Equipe de Saúde Digital! A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicas e Médicos Especialistas em Endocrinologia! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando. * SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: * A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas. * O QUE PROCURAMOS: * Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na modalidade de consultas de especialidade em Endocrinologia, de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;
DESCRIÇÃO DAS ATIVIDADES: Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Endocrinologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação. Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endocrinológicos. Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de conduzir anamnese virtual para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de risco e gravidade em Endocrinologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial. Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa. Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente. Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças Endocrinológicas. Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina. Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento. Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas. Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca dos principais problemas de saúde em Endocrinologia. Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo. Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde. Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado. Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais. Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo. Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes. Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição. REQUISITOS Formação Acadêmica: Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EM ENDOCRINOLOGIA, concluída ou em andamento. Certificações: Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
Certificado de Títulode Especialista - RQE (emitido pelo Conselho respectivo) em Endocrinologia, ou comprovante de matrícula em Residência, Pós Graduação, Especialização em Endocrinologia. Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil). Experiência: Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Endocrinologia, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;
Conhecimentos Específicos para a função: Prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endócrinos e metabólicos.. Competências Comportamentais: Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional. Outros Requisitos Importantes: Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável. Local de Trabalho: REMOTO I MPORTANTE: MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo. Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Clínico/Generalista Residente em Endocrinologia.

title: Database Administrator
description: As a Database Administrator, you will responsible for end-to-end administration of Oracle 19c clustered database platforms. You will be responsible for managing all oracle databases and applications, all database objects, tuning, cloning, patching, and replication. Work Schedule: For the first six months, this role will work a standard 9:00 AM–6:00 PM BRT schedule. After the initial six-month period, the schedule will transition to 4:00 AM –1:00 PM BRT. Responsibilities: Creates and maintains all databases required for development, testing, pre-prod and production usage. Install new versions of the Oracle database in cluster and standalone environments. Plans and implements backup and recovery of the Oracle database. Plan, configure Disaster Recovery environment using Data Guard, and perform Disaster Recovery test. Controls migration of programs, database changes, reference data changes through the development life cycle Implement operational automation using Ansible and shell scripting. Perform complex performance turning and optimization for operational efficiency. Utilizing tuning utilities and reports such as AWR, ASH, ADDM, SQLT, SQL Tuning Advisor, SQL tracing and analysis, and database event tracing. Perform frequent database refreshes and migrations. Enforces and maintains database constraints to ensure integrity of the database. Administers all database objects, including tables, clusters, indexes, views, sequences, packages and procedures. Discover and implement performance and uptime improvement strategies. Assists with impact analysis of any changes made to the database objects. Leverage Oracle expertise and knowledge by providing PLSQL tuning recommendations to developers. Participate in 24/7 on-call rotation for various Production support & database maintenance activities. Qualifications: Bachelor’s Degree or higher in Information System, Computer Science or work equivalent Proven 5 to 7 years of Oracle DBA experience. A minimum of 5 years of database support and design experience and migration/upgrade experience with Oracle. 3+ years of experience administering Oracle RAC environments. Experience working with Oracle RAC cluster and 19c database, preferable with multi-tenant architecture. Work experience with installing and supporting Golden Gate, and configuring GoldenGate to be used as replication tool. Experience in installation, configuration and marinating Oracle RAC in Virtualized (VM) environment. Experience in building a DR database using DataGuard, and experience in planning and supporting Disaster Recovery testing. Working knowledge of Cloud infrastructure such as AWS Or OCI A good knowledge of LINUX and Windows operating system(s) Experience in Ansible or similar configuration management tools is desirable. Good knowledge of Oracle backup and recovery scenarios. A good knowledge & experience in using and configuring OEM Experience and knowledge in migrating code, database changes and data through the various stages of the development life cycle.

Descrição da vaga

Em 2017, a Companhia realizou seu primeiro investimento ao adquirir o Vera Cruz Hospital, localizado na cidade Campinas-SP, que com mais de 80 anos de atuação, é um dos mais tradicionais hospitais da cidade. O hospital atualmente conta com 11 salas cirúrgicas, 08 Leitos de Apoio Cirúrgico, 110 leitos de internação, 14 leitos de UTI Adulto, 10 leitos de Unidade Cardiológica, 10 leitos Semi-intensiva, 16 leitos Maternidade/Alojamento Conjunto, 09 leitos Pediatria e Pronto Socorro 24h. Além de atender mais de 66 especialidades, ter acreditação ONA 3 e ter conquistado em 2025 a importantíssima acreditação da JCI.

Desde então, por meio do Vera Cruz Hospital, aumentamos nossa rede de forma substancial em Campinas e região. Com a inauguração, por exemplo, de serviços novos como os Centros de Oncologia, Neurologia, Cardiologia, Ortopedia, a Unidade de Atenção Primária da Saúde e a criação das unidades avançadas em Indaiatuba.

Além disso, realizamos também a aquisição da Casa de Saúde Campinas, um dos hospitais mais importantes da história da cidade, localizado em um prédio centenário, parte do acervo arquitetônico da cidade. Nesse mesmo processo de consolidação regional, adquirimos também a operadora de saúde Vera Cruz, atualmente denominada 2Care.

A regional faz parte do grupo Hospital Care que em 2017, a união das pessoas com o sonho de transformar a saúde suplementar do Brasil, possibilitou o início da trajetória da companhia. Somos uma holding administradora de serviços de saúde que propõe um modelo inovador de gestão integrada, tendo como objetivo promover o equilíbrio de interesses entre pacientes, médicos, fontes pagadoras, parceiros e acionistas. Para isso, conta com um sistema de saúde completo com hospitais de alta complexidade, laboratórios de exames, planos de saúde e centros médicos.

Como estratégia de atuação, está presente em cidades que funcionam como polos regionais para a gestão de saúde, dentro de três estados, São Paulo, Paraná e Florianópolis. Esse conjunto de operações tem como objetivo nos tornar a melhor Rede de Prestadores de Saúde Privada do Brasil.

Descrição da vaga

To work in Extreme Conditions X-ray Diffraction and Spectroscopy Group (EXT) of the Brazilian Synchrotron Light Laboratory (LNLS).

LNLS/CNPEM is seeking a Senior Researcher to lead the Extreme Conditions X-ray Diffraction and Spectroscopy Group (EXT) at SIRIUS, Brazil’s fourth-generation synchrotron light source. The selected candidate will also serve as scientific coordinator of the EMA beamline.

The EXT group brings together experimental infrastructure dedicated to structural and electronic studies of matter under extreme conditions of pressure, temperature, and external fields, integrating multiple experimental and laboratory platforms, including:

EMA Beamline (to be coordinated by the selected candidate)

X-ray diffraction and spectroscopy experiments at high pressure and temperature;

Use of diamond anvil cells and resistive/laser heating;

In situ structural and electronic studies in materials science, geosciences, and condensed matter.

Seriema Beamline (under development)

Fast and large-scale diffraction and spectroscopy experiments using micrometric beams at high pressure.

High-Pressure Laboratory

Sample preparation and characterization;

Experimental and instrumental development associated with pressure cells;

Support for synchrotron experiments and the user community.

Responsabilidades e atribuições
  • Lead the EXT group and define its scientific strategy;
  • Coordinate the operation and scientific program of the EMA beamline;
  • Promote integration between EMA and Seriema beamlines and the high‑pressure laboratory;
  • Manage a multidisciplinary team of researchers, engineers, and technicians;
  • Develop new experimental methodologies in diffraction and spectroscopy under extreme conditions;
  • Establish national and international collaborations and strengthen the user community;
  • Foster scientific programs in quantum materials, geosciences, and functional materials under extreme conditions.
Requisitos e qualificações
  • PhD in Physics, Chemistry, Materials Science, or related fields;
  • Advanced English;
  • Solid experience in high‑pressure X‑ray techniques (diffraction and/or spectroscopy);
  • Track record of work at large‑scale scientific facilities (preferably synchrotrons);
  • Experience in scientific leadership, team management, and coordination of complex projects;
  • Strategic vision and ability to integrate instrumentation development, science, and user support;
  • Strong publication record and international recognition in the field.

title: [job-27863] Gerente de Projetos Senior, Brasil.
description:
Somos especialistas em transformação tecnológica , unindo expertise humana à IA para criar soluções tech escaláveis. Com mais de 8,000 CI&Ters ao redor do mundo, já formamos parcerias com mais de 1,000 clientes durante nossos 30 anos de história. Inteligência Artificial é nossa realidade.

Importante : se você reside na Região Metropolitana de Campinas, sua presença nos escritórios da cidade será obrigatória, conforme a política de frequência vigente.

Objetivo do papel: Gerenciar estrategicamente programas e projetos (com ênfase em contratos de escopo fechado/fixed price), assegurando entrega dentro do escopo, prazo, custo e qualidade acordados. Atuar como principal responsável pela definição, revisão e negociação do SDLC com o cliente (incluindo nível executivo), pela governança de change requests, e pela eficácia operacional e financeira do portfólio, impulsionando crescimento, inovação e expansão de negócios com disciplina de execução.

Principais Responsabilidades/Atividades Liderança e Desenvolvimento de Equipes

Liderar equipes multidisciplinares de alto desempenho, promovendo colaboração, crescimento e segurança psicológica.

Formar sucessores e fortalecer a trilha de gestão, com coaching e feedback contínuos.

Gestão de Projetos de Escopo Fechado

Estruturar EAP/WBS, baseline de escopo, cronograma e orçamento; definir caminhos críticos, dependências e marcos.

Aplicar monitoramento de valor e desempenho (ex.: EVM – CPI/SPI) e gerir variações de prazo e custo.

Garantir compliance com SOW/MSA, deliverables, aceite formal e critérios de conclusão (Definition of Done/Acceptance).

Controle e Negociação de Change Requests (CR)

Operar processo formal de CR: triagem, impacto em escopo/prazo/custo, business case e recomendação.

Negociar CRs com stakeholders e executivos do cliente, assegurando sustentabilidade econômica (margem) e viabilidade de prazo.

Manter rastreabilidade de baseline vs. mudanças e governança transparente de decisão.

SDLC: Definição, Revisão e Negociação com o Cliente

Desenhar e customizar o SDLC (ágil, híbrido ou waterfall) conforme o contexto e as restrições do contrato.

Estabelecer e negociar stage gates/tollgates, critérios de qualidade, DOR/DOD, governança de releases e padrões de documentação.

Conduzir alinhamentos executivos para equilibrar time-to-market, risco, compliance (segurança/privacidade/SoX, quando aplicável) e custo.

Estratégia de Negócios e Execução do Roadmap

Traduzir objetivos estratégicos em planos de entrega; priorizar iniciativas conforme valor e restrições contratuais.

Promover gestão integrada de portfólio, removendo bloqueios e gargalos end-to-end no fluxo de valor.

Gestão de Recursos, Orçamento e Cronogramas

Planejar capacidade e perfis; otimizar alocação para atender baseline e metas financeiras.

Acompanhar burn rate, margem, variações e previsões; acionar planos de correção.

Métricas e Desempenho

Implantar e acompanhar métricas de entrega (on-time/on-budget, CPI/SPI, lead/cycle time, throughput), qualidade (defect leakage, retrabalho) e negócio (CSAT/NPS, adoção).

Reportar desempenho operacional e financeiro, identificando melhorias e implementando ações corretivas/preventivas.

Metodologias Lean/Agile e Excelência Operacional

Aplicar princípios Lean/Agile de forma pragmática em projetos de escopo fechado (cadências, limites WIP, gestão visual).

Fomentar melhoria contínua, padronização, automação e uso de AI/GenAI quando gerem ganhos comprovados.

Relações Estratégicas e Governança com o Cliente

Construir relacionamentos no nível executivo; facilitar comitês de direção/steerco e ritos de governança.

Negociar trade-offs de escopo, custo e prazo com base em dados e risco.

Gestão de Riscos e Conformidade

Mapear riscos e premissas; implementar respostas e planos de contingência.

Garantir conformidade com políticas, segurança e requisitos regulatórios aplicáveis.

Pre-sales e Expansão

Apoiar propostas (estimativas, cronogramas, abordagem/SDLC, riscos, supostos) e conduzir due diligence.

Conectar problemas do cliente a propostas de valor sustentáveis (land & expand) com disciplina contratual.

Ferramentas e Processos

Implementar e gerir ferramentas de gestão de projetos/portfolio (ex.: Jira/Advanced Roadmaps, MS Project, ServiceNow, Power BI).

Instituir processos críticos, RACI claro, base documental e trilhas de aprovação.

Requisitos (must-have)

Experiência sólida gerenciando projetos de escopo fechado/fixed price, com histórico comprovado de entrega on-time/on-budget e gestão de margem.

Domínio de processos formais de change request: avaliação de impacto, negociação executiva e governança de baseline.

Vivência em revisão, desenho e negociação de SDLC com clientes, incluindo interlocução em nível executivo (ágil, híbrido e waterfall).

Forte gestão financeira de projetos: orçamento, EVM (CPI/SPI), previsões, KPIs de margem.

description:
Overview

Descrição da vaga To work in Extreme Conditions X-ray Diffraction and Spectroscopy Group (EXT) of the Brazilian Synchrotron Light Laboratory (LNLS).

LNLS/CNPEM is seeking a Senior Researcher to lead the Extreme Conditions X-ray Diffraction and Spectroscopy Group (EXT) at SIRIUS, Brazil’s fourth-generation synchrotron light source. The selected candidate will also serve as scientific coordinator of the EMA beamline.

The EXT Group Brings Together Experimental Infrastructure Dedicated To Structural And Electronic Studies Of Matter Under Extreme Conditions Of Pressure, Temperature, And External Fields, Integrating Multiple Experimental And Laboratory Platforms, Including

EMA Beamline (to be coordinated by the selected candidate)

X-ray diffraction and spectroscopy experiments at high pressure and temperature;

Use of diamond anvil cells and resistive/laser heating;

In situ structural and electronic studies in materials science, geosciences, and condensed matter.

Seriema Beamline (under development)

Fast and large-scale diffraction and spectroscopy experiments using micrometric beams at high pressure.

High-Pressure Laboratory

Sample preparation and characterization;

Experimental and instrumental development associated with pressure cells;

Support for synchrotron experiments and the user community.

Responsibilities and qualifications
  • Lead the EXT group and define its scientific strategy;
  • Coordinate the operation and scientific program of the EMA beamline;
  • Promote integration between EMA and Seriema beamlines and the high-pressure laboratory;
  • Manage a multidisciplinary team of researchers, engineers, and technicians;
  • Develop new experimental methodologies in diffraction and spectroscopy under extreme conditions;
  • Establish national and international collaborations and strengthen the user community;
  • Foster scientific programs in quantum materials, geosciences, and functional materials under extreme conditions.
Requisitos e qualificações
  • PhD in Physics, Chemistry, Materials Science, or related fields;
  • Advanced English;
  • Solid experience in high-pressure X-ray techniques (diffraction and/or spectroscopy);
  • Track record of work at large-scale scientific facilities (preferably synchrotrons);
  • Experience in scientific leadership, team management, and coordination of complex projects;
  • Strategic vision and ability to integrate instrumentation development, science, and user support;
  • Strong publication record and international recognition in the field.

We reaffirm our commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion, encouraging applications from people with disabilities, neurodivergent individuals, women, LGBTI+ people, individuals from diverse ethnic backgrounds, generations, and body types, as well as other socially marginalized groups.

Faça parte do CNPEM!

No Centro Nacional de Pesquisa em Energia e Materiais (CNPEM), somos movidos pela paixão pela ciência. Nosso ambiente é um vibrante centro de pesquisa e desenvolvimento, onde profissionais de diversas especialidades se conectam para enfrentar desafios complexos e criar soluções para problemas relevantes, especialmente nas áreas de saúde, energia, materiais renováveis e sustentabilidade.

Somos uma Organização Social supervisionada pelo Ministério da Ciência, Tecnologia e Inovação (MCTI), na vanguarda da pesquisa científica no Brasil. Somos responsáveis pelo Sirius, a maior infraestrutura científica já construída no País, e atualmente, desenvolvemos o projeto Orion, um complexo laboratorial dedicado a pesquisas avançadas em patógenos, que estará disponível para a comunidade científica nacional e internacional.

Oferecemos uma ampla gama de oportunidades de carreira para profissionais de diferentes perfis. No CNPEM, conduzimos pesquisas de ponta que abrangem nanotecnologia, biociências, biotecnologia, biorrenováveis, instrumentação científica e física de aceleradores, conduzidas, respectivamente, pelos Laboratórios Nacionais de Nanotecnologia (LNNano), Biociências (LNBio), Biorrenováveis (LNBR) e Luz Síncrotron (LNLS). Essas iniciativas são fortalecidas por projetos tecnológicos desafiadores e pela busca de soluções na fronteira das engenharias, liderados pela Diretoria Adjunta de Tecnologia (DAT).

A Ilum Escola de Ciência complementa essas frentes com um curso de bacharelado em Ciência e Tecnologia, oferecendo uma formação inovadora que prepara novas gerações de cientistas para os desafios do futuro.

  • Liderança: Formatar e posicionar um time técnico de referência. Você definirá papéis claros, garantirá a senioridade adequada e estabelecerá a autoridade arquitetural necessária para acelerar o crescimento e a escala da conta.
  • Engenharia com IA: Liderar a transformação da nossa produtividade, colocando IA no core do SDLC. Você será o mentor de práticas avançadas de automação, otimização de Flow e qualidade, elevando a barra de velocidade da operação.
  • Visibilidade e Conexão com o Business: Transformar decisões técnicas complexas em valor visível para o cliente. Você tornará a arquitetura explicável e diretamente conectada ao impacto no produto e nos resultados de negócio.

  • Diferenciação: Identificar e tracionar novas oportunidades no mundo digital através de diferenciais tecnológicos.
  • Experiência Multidisciplinar: Carreira sólida e comprovada em arquitetura de sistemas de larga escala, tendo atuado em diferentes indústrias e contextos técnicos.
  • Visão de Negócio: Capacidade de traduzir "técnico" para executivos, demonstrando como a engenharia de valor.
  • Boas práticas de Engenharia: Conhecimento em Cloud, DevOps e, na aplicação de GenAI para aceleração de desenvolvimento.
  • Liderança por Influência: Habilidade de atuar de forma transversal (cross-GU), mentorando lideranças técnicas e influenciando stakeholders de alto nível.
  • Mindset de Crescimento: Foco em excelência operacional mas com "olhar de vendas", identificando onde a tecnologia pode abrir portas para novos projetos.
